name: Gotalk
description_en:
Gotalk is a product in the Video conferencing category. Its directory profile covers Guest users, Participant Permissions, Hand Raising, Meeting Scheduler, Audio Conferencing, Switch Presenter, Live Preview, Virtual Whiteboard.

Additional listed capabilities include HD Video Streaming, File Sharing, Session Recording, Remote Control, Screen Sharing, Live Chat. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $8.99. Offers Free-forever and Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: connect meeting participants using audio; make files available to authorized participants; show a participant's screen to other attendees; exchange messages with visitors or customers in real time. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
Gotalk 属于视频会议软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括访客用户、参与者权限、举手发言、会议安排、音频会议、演示者切换、实时预览、在线白板。

资料还列出高清视频传输、文件共享、会话录制、远程控制、屏幕共享、在线聊天。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：未提供免费试用 起价为 $8.99. 另有持续免费方案和定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：通过音频连接会议参与者；向获授权的参与者共享文件；向其他参与者展示屏幕内容；与访客或客户实时交换消息。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
